svg.aria-label: Quality vs AI Credits and Wall-Clock Time across 28 GitHub Copilot models on 8 creative tasks
svg.text: 224 Multimodal Agent Runs · 28 Models × 8 Tasks (40% Headless Checks + 60% Dual LLM Judges)
The 163× Cost Compression Frontier: Top-Tier Quality Spans 4 Points While Cost Spans 9 to 1,475 Credits
Left: 8-task mean quality vs. total AI credits (log scale). Right: 8-task mean quality vs. wall-clock minutes (√-scale). Green band marks the 14-model top cluster (86.2–90.4).
▲ Top-14 Compressed Frontier (86.2 ≤ Q ≤ 90.4 · 163× Credit Spread)
▲ Top-14 Compressed Frontier (12.9 min to 85.6 min Wall Time)
A. Total 8-Task AI Credits & Compute Cost (log scale · 1 cr = $0.01)
Note: Quality = 0.4 × automated headless checks + 0.6 × mean judge score (claude-opus-5.5 & gpt-5.5). Dashed red rings in Panel B mark models with cell timeouts (20–25m cap).
